messages.content: Predict the distribution of responses from participants in Mixed Messages, a generative art project. These are this audience's interpretations, not objective labels. Reply with a single JSON object only. No prose or code fences.

WORD: "MEMORY"

Estimate the share of this audience's submissions in each quadrant:
performed+uniting: creating false unity among us
honest+uniting: bringing us together, authentically
performed+dividing: exploiting our divisions, deliberately
honest+dividing: fracturing us, truthfully

Return exactly these four keys with numeric probabilities between 0 and 1 that sum to 1 (not percentages). Use at least three decimal places when needed. A sum differing from 1 by at most 0.001 will be normalized. Do not include confidence, explanations, or any other keys.
{"performed+uniting": <probability>, "honest+uniting": <probability>, "performed+dividing": <probability>, "honest+dividing": <probability>}

message.reasoning:
The task: predict distribution of audience interpretations for the word "MEMORY" in a Mixed Messages generative art project, mapped onto quadrants: performed+uniting (false unity), honest+uniting (authentic togetherness), performed+dividing (exploiting divisions), honest+dividing (truthful fracturing).

Memory as a concept: shared memory brings people together authentically (commemorations, collective memory, nostalgia). Memory can also be performed — nostalgia marketing, manufactured nostalgia, false collective memory, "the good old days" mythmaking that creates false unity. Memory can divide honestly — contested histories, truth and reconciliation, remembering grievances, historical injustices truthfully acknowledged fracture communities. Memory can divide performed — weaponized memory, political exploitation of historical grievances to divide (memory wars, culture wars invoking the past).

Audience interpretations for "MEMORY": likely many see memory as honest+uniting (shared memories bond people, nostalgia, collective identity). Some see performed+uniting (manufactured nostalgia, false collective memory, revisionism creating false unity). Some see honest+dividing (memory of trauma, honest remembrance of injustices divides). Some performed+dividing (weaponized memory, propaganda exploiting past divisions).

Estimate: honest+uniting dominant ~0.42; performed+uniting ~0.22; honest+dividing ~0.24; performed+dividing ~0.12. Sum = 1.000.

Let me pick: performed+uniting 0.215, honest+uniting 0.425, performed+dividing 0.125, honest+dividing 0.235. Sum = 1.000.
